statement.en: Describing the parts separately gives back the whole exactly where it is rectangular; a relation forms only by joint action, lasts under separate laws that merge nothing that occurs, and ends only by loss or joint action; parity is a whole its pairs do not give back.
statement.zh: 分别描述各部分恰在整体为矩形处给回整体；关系只由共同作用形成，在不合并出现者的各自之律下持续，只由失去或共同作用结束；奇偶是诸对不给回的整体。

laws.en: For a whole on A × B, the combinations that occur, it is rectangular where whatever goes with one part goes with every other: (a, b) and (a′, b′) occurring give (a, b′). Its separated description admits a pair where each part occurs with something. Separation keeps every combination that occurs, and admits only what occurs exactly where the whole is rectangular.
laws.zh: 对 A × B 上的整体（出现的组合），矩形是指与一个部分同出现的都与每个其他部分同出现：(a, b) 与 (a′, b′) 出现给出 (a, b′)。其分离描述容许每个部分都与某物同出现的对。分离保留每个出现的组合，且恰在整体为矩形处只容许出现者。

laws.en: Two parts that always go alike, described separately, can go apart: for the whole on Bool × Bool where the parts are equal, the separated description admits (true, false), which does not occur.
laws.zh: 总是相同的两个部分，分别描述时可以分开：在 Bool × Bool 上两部分相等的整体中，分离描述容许不出现的 (true, false)。

laws.en: A relation held by the whole and by no pair: in the even-parity triples on Bool, any two values of any two places complete to an even triple, and (true, false, false) is not one.
laws.zh: 整体持有而任何一对都不持有的关系：在 Bool 上偶奇偶的三元组中，任意两个位置的任意两个值都能补成偶三元组，而 (true, false, false) 不是。

laws.en: On Specker's three boxes read through their three pairs, every reading of the boxes is allowed by every pair under even parity, and the pairs do not give the whole back: not every reading the pairs allow is of even parity.
laws.zh: 在 Specker 的三个盒子上经三对读：偶奇偶之下每种读法都被每一对容许，而诸对不给回整体：诸对都容许的读法并非都是偶奇偶。

laws.en: A law's image of a whole is the configurations it leads to from the whole. A law moving each part by itself, (a, b) to (f a, g b) for any f and g, keeps a rectangular whole rectangular. The law copying the first part into the second leads from the full whole on Bool × Bool to the parts being equal, which is not rectangular.
laws.zh: 律对整体的像是它从整体导向的构形。各自移动每个部分的律（对任意 f、g，把 (a, b) 带到 (f a, g b)）使矩形的整体保持矩形。把第一部分复制到第二部分的律，从 Bool × Bool 上的全部整体导向两部分相等，那不是矩形。

laws.en: Where f merges no two first parts that occur in the whole and g no two second parts, a rectangular image under the law moving each part by itself comes only from a rectangular whole, so a whole that is not rectangular stays so under that law.
laws.zh: f 不合并整体中出现的任何两个第一部分、g 不合并任何两个第二部分时，各自移动每个部分之律下矩形的像只来自矩形的整体，所以不是矩形的整体在该律下仍不是矩形。

laws.en: A law sending the first part to one value, however it moves the second, leads from any whole to a rectangular one.
laws.zh: 把第一部分送到同一个值的律，无论怎样移动第二部分，都从任何整体导向矩形的整体。

laws.en: The coupling taking (x, y) to (x, y turned over where x holds) on Bool × Bool undoes itself; it leads from “the second part is false”, which is rectangular, to a whole that is not rectangular, and acting again leads back to “the second part is false”.
laws.zh: Bool × Bool 上的耦合把 (x, y) 带到 (x, x 成立时翻转的 y)，自身可逆；它从矩形的“第二部分为假”导向不是矩形的整体，再作用一次回到“第二部分为假”。

laws.en: Along the courses of n moves of a determined law's process from a whole: under a law moving each part by itself, a rectangular whole reaches only rectangular wholes at every n; where f and g merge nothing at all, a whole that is not rectangular reaches only wholes that are not rectangular at every n.
laws.zh: 沿确定之律的过程从整体出发 n 步的历程：在各自移动每个部分的律下，矩形的整体在每个 n 只到达矩形的整体；f 与 g 完全不合并时，不是矩形的整体在每个 n 只到达不是矩形的整体。

laws.en: Along such courses, one move of copying the first part into the second leads from every configuration of Bool × Bool to the parts being equal, not rectangular; after one move of a law sending the first part to one value, every course leads to a rectangular whole; one move of the coupling from “the second part is false” leads to a whole that is not rectangular, and two moves lead back.
laws.zh: 沿这样的历程：复制第一部分的一步从 Bool × Bool 的每个构形导向两部分相等，不是矩形；把第一部分送到同一值之律走过一步后，每个历程都导向矩形的整体；耦合从“第二部分为假”走一步导向不是矩形的整体，走两步回到原处。

hypotheses.zh: 不加前提：separation_faithful_iff 是双向的，对每个整体成立；Rectangular.image_of_separate 对任何 f、g 成立。
hypotheses.en: No premise: separation_faithful_iff is two-way and holds for every whole; Rectangular.image_of_separate holds for any f and g.
relation_persists needs f and g to merge nothing that occurs, and relation_persists_courses to merge nothing at all (local conditions, written into the theorems).
hypotheses.zh: relation_persists 要 f 与 g 在出现者上不合并，relation_persists_courses 要它们完全不合并（局部条件，写在定理之中）。
见证的结论：奇偶、复制与 couple 都在 Bool 上。
hypotheses.en: For the witnesses: parity, copying and couple are on Bool.

does_not_show.en: Relation is stated for wholes of two parts, by rectangularity, the standard product criterion; three parts enter only through the parity witness.
does_not_show.zh: 关系只对两个部分的整体陈述，以矩形即乘积的标准判据；三个部分只经奇偶的见证出现。

does_not_show.en: The laws do not characterize which joint laws keep wholes rectangular.
does_not_show.zh: 这些规律没有刻画哪些共同之律保持整体为矩形。

does_not_show.en: That a joint law merging nothing can end a relation rests on one witness, the coupling on Bool × Bool.
does_not_show.zh: 不合并任何东西的共同之律可以结束关系，只有一个见证：Bool × Bool 上的耦合。

does_not_show.en: Parts giving back a whole across contexts and the separation of two parts are not stated as instance and law of each other, the two parts having different types.
does_not_show.zh: 语境中诸部分给回整体与两部分的分离，没有被陈述为彼此的实例与规律（两个部分的类型不同）。

detail.zh: 不是矩形的整体分别描述时多出组合（separation_admits_extra）；三个部分的偶奇偶不被任何一对持有（whole_not_in_pairs）；一个无损的耦合可以结束关系（coupling_relates_and_unrelates），所以“不失去什么”不足以保持关系，要加“各自移动每个部分”。
detail.en: A whole that is not rectangular gains combinations when described separately (separation_admits_extra); the even parity of three parts is held by no pair (whole_not_in_pairs); a lossless coupling can end a relation (coupling_relates_and_unrelates), so losing nothing does not keep a relation without “moving each part by itself”.

correspondence.en: Following Ren's “push the frontier, as far as possible” of 12 October 2026, answering Ren's “the framing may lose something” and “what makes a pair, a pair?”: what describing the parts separately deducts is exactly the relation; “what can go together” is the record at a moment of “how they go on”. Readings (an AI reading): a correlation is the memory of a meeting; 三生万物 read as three being the least number at which a whole holds a relation no part holds. The other way parts fail a whole (parts allowing what no whole has) is no_whole of claims-shown-in-context, on the same three pairs.

detail.en: A projection carries a law exactly where what it lumps goes alike; here laws moving each part by itself keep wholes rectangular, and joint laws can relate or unrelate the parts.

detail.en: The exact law for the same kind of case of parts failing a whole: for parity constraints, context-free readings exist exactly where no selection of contexts contradicts.
